meta.title: Withdraw an event that is live with two bids and press Cancel in the pop-up
gaps: Start from a live RFQ with two bids, specifically bids A 100 and B 90; the prepared state is fixed with one bid and cannot be modified before this check.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Start from a live RFQ with two bids, specifically bids A 100 and B 90; the prepared state is fixed with one bid and cannot be modified before this check.

steps.note: Open the prepared event's buyer summary page; this is the required entry point for an existing prepared event.
Open the project menu and choose Withdraw Project to display the confirmation pop-up without completing the withdrawal.
Verify the withdrawal confirmation pop-up is open.

args.text: Are you sure you want to withdraw this event?

steps.note: Verify the pop-up asks for confirmation before withdrawal.
Cancel the withdrawal instead of confirming it.
Verify the confirmation pop-up closes after cancellation.
Verify the event remains live and was not withdrawn.
